{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|servings=8|time=1½ hour|difficulty=3}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

==Ingredients==

* 24-[[Cookbook:Ounce|ounce]] jar picante sauce
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] packed [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* ¼ cup all-purpose [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* ⅛ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 can (29 ounces) [[Cookbook:Peach|cling peach halves]], drained and [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]]
* ½ package (15 ounces) refrigerated [[Cookbook:Pie Crust|pie crust]] (1 crust)

==Procedure==

# Mix picante sauce, brown sugar, flour, cinnamon, and salt in 3-[[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]].
# Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture [[Cookbook:Boil|boils]].
# Reduce heat to low.
# Cook and stir 2 minutes more or until mixture thickens.
# Stir in peaches. Remove from heat and let cool.
# Pour mixture into 9-inch deep-dish [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie plate]].
# Heat oven to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|400°F]].
# Let pie crust stand at room temperature 15 minutes or until it's easy to handle.
# Gently put the pie crust over the sauce mixture. Crimp or roll edges to seal.
# Cut slits in crust with knife.
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] for 40 minutes or until crust is golden brown.
# Serve warm.
